summary: Ally Financial filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, announcing the launch of a proposed public offering of Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series D. The offering is not yet priced and may proceed to close, with net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes, potentially including redemption of some or all of its Series B Preferred Stock. The filing is a routine capital markets update, not a special situation. The decision to redeem the Series B will depend on market conditions. No specific terms, advisor, or board recommendation are provided. Watch for pricing and any subsequent redemption announcement.
